dog.description_text:
Meet Isaiah, a sweet and friendly senior boy looking for a loving home to spend his golden years. Isaiah may be blind, but that doesn’t stop him from enjoying life to the fullest. He’s still a happy, energetic pup who loves going on walks and taking in all the exciting smells around him.

Isaiah would thrive in a safe, patient, and understanding home that can help him navigate the world with confidence. A consistent environment and a compassionate adopter will help him continue to shine. In return, Isaiah will reward you with endless love, companionship, and a gentle spirit that’s impossible not to adore.

If you’re looking for a loyal best friend with a heart of gold, Isaiah could be the perfect match for you! Please fill out and submit an adoption application today
